text:
jess: Heads-up — PR #9123 is green and ready to merge but it’s gated on the architecture RFC. RFC: https://rwd-internal.company/rfcs/453 (kv-cache / routing changes). Can someone from arch take a quick look? cc @omar @liz
omar: Thanks — pulling up the RFC now. Quick question: does the PR change the shard affinity algorithm or only the routing policy?
liz: It touches routing policy + a tiny runtime shim for fallbacks. No shard leader changes. I left notes in the PR about the fallback order.
jess: Correct — only policy-level routing. The shim is conservative: if model variant X is unavailable we route to X-quantized then to fallback-Y. No leader election changes.
omar: OK. Can you add the SLO delta (p50/p99) and expected token cost delta? Those are required for architecture sign-off.
jess: Will do in a sec. Rough numbers from local perf: p50 +3ms, p99 +12ms, token cost +0.7% at default batching. Adding them to the PR description now.
liz: Also adding the canary plan. Proposed: 10% traffic for 6 hours, then 50% for 12h, then full rollout. Feature flag + automatic rollback on error-rate > 0.5% or latency regression > 15%.
kai: quick safety check: do metrics emit the new route tags? We need per-route traces for perf dashboards.
jess: yes — I added route=policy_v2 and fallback tags to traces and metrics. Example: code snippet in PR: `tracing.set_tag("route", "policy_v2")` and added metrics `route_fallback_count`.
omar: Nice. One more ask: show a short runbook for rollback steps if the canary fails (who’s the oncall, ANR contact, etc.).
jess: Added a short rollback checklist in the PR description and the runbook doc: 1) disable flag (admin UI), 2) revert canary, 3) force old-routing via emergency toggle, 4) open incident. Oncall is @kai for today.
liz: I’ll do an architecture read now. If I’m good I can give sign-off.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: PR #9123 -> canary 10% for 6h (scheduled start: 1768676000).
omar: After liz sign-off, can we coordinate merge timing with releases team? We don’t want a simultaneous release that bumps infra.
jess: Yes — aim to merge during the 8–11am PT release window tomorrow. I’ll ping releases when we have arch LGTM.
liz: Reviewing — a couple minor comments but nothing blocking. One note about config defaults — please keep fallback timeout at 30ms per SLA.
jess: Adjusting defaults now. Thanks.
liz: LGTM (architectural). :white_check_mark:
omar: Arch +1 from me as well.
kai: Oncall +1 to proceed with scheduled canary. I’ll monitor dashboards during the canary.
jess: Thanks everyone — merging after I update the timeout and push one more small patch. I’ll update the thread when canary starts. :thumbsup:
